verdict.rationale: Productboard's REST API documents deleting customer feedback records and their relationships, which gives some product-level control over data deletion. Nothing in the evidence describes retention policies, retention periods, workspace or account data purging, or AI/agent data-handling controls. missing for 10: configurable data-retention policies, workspace/account-level deletion or purge controls, AI-specific data retention/usage controls, documentation of deletion guarantees, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Create, read, update, delete, and search customer feedback, complete with text content, tags, owners, source metadata, and customer attribution.
Dedicated endpoints create, list, and delete these relationships.
